messages:
Maya: Heat check — quick 1-line scores for three candidates please (format below). I want a shortlist by EOD so we can decide canary targets for next sprint.

Use one-line per model: Model | Q:1-5 | L:1-5 | C:1-5 | R:1-5 | short note

Maya: Candidates: Kestrel-30b, Ember-13b (8-bit qual), Tempest-70B-pt (fine-tuned long-context).

Sam: Kestrel-30b | Q:4 L:3 C:3 R:4 | solid summarization + QA, 1 known safety edge-case to re-test.

Alex: Ember-13b-quant | Q:3 L:2 C:2 R:5 | quant gives nice perf boost, some hallucination drift on multi-turn chains — need eval set.

Liam: Tempest-70B-pt | Q:5 L:1 C:5 R:3 | top quality for long-context features, infra heavy (GPU mem + ECC), fits roadmap for docs product.

Sam: Quick note on Kestrel perf: good throughput on A100s but kv-cache not great for >8k context yet.

Devex Bot: perf snapshot for latest smoke runs:
```
Kestrel-30b:
  p50: 210ms (batch=8)
  tokens/s: 320
Ember-13b-quant:
  p50: 92ms (batch=16)
  tokens/s: 980
Tempest-70B-pt:
  p50: 420ms (batch=4)
  tokens/s: 140
```

Alex: Ember note — quant config tried: 8-bit asymmetric + per-channel. We saw small drop on codegen evals, ok on chat. Will re-run with 4-bit qlist next week.

Maya: Thanks. Quick rubric I'm using for shortlist (for anyone who wants to copy):
```
Quality (Q): accuracy/fluency on eval set 1-5
Latency (L): p50 relative to baseline 1-5 (5=best/fastest)
Cost (C): infra cost 1-5 (5=cheapest)
Roadmap fit (R): matches 0-2 quarter initiatives 1-5
```

Liam: Can infra support Kestrel canary + Ember-quant simultaneously next sprint? likely yes if we enable burst on dedicated pool, but Tempest needs a separate ticket. @Maya assign infra ticket?

Maya: Yes please. Shortlist for canary: Kestrel-30b, Ember-13b-quant. Tempest into "feature pilot" queue. @Liam can you create capacity ticket and tag "canary-week-11"?

Liam: Will do. I created infra ticket INF-4127 and linked canary pool config.

Sam: I'll start an eval deck (short test corpus + safety checks) and upload to the drive. Expect link by EOD.

Maya: Perfect. Action items: Sam -> eval deck, Liam -> INF-4127 + pool, Alex -> 4-bit quant run on Ember next week, Maya -> create canary rollout plan + metrics. 

Maya: Thanks all :thumbsup:
